notes.title: RESULTS OF 2024 AND PLANS
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/8576dcf05bf09b47b06c1b6a378e0a764cc0b25f.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

Let me share a bit about the year’s results and plans for the next one.

The year was challenging—one might even say unsuccessful—but I’ve managed to make some progress, however small.

You can follow the news on my [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/legendsofsavvarah/]Reddit community[/url]. There, I also occasionally write about the creation process and share more details about the Savvarah universe.

Everything will be divided into two sections: [RESULTS] and [PLANS].

[h1][b]RESULTS:[/b][/h1]

[b]1. The release of Legends of Savvarah: The Time of the Pariah.[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416500/Legends_of_Savvarah_Time_of_Pariah/]LINK
[/url]
This year marked the release of a completed game set in the world of Savvarah.

Overall, I consider it a failure, but having a release is still an achievement.

Why do I see it as a failure?

- Several questionable creative decisions, less-than-ideal variability, and other choices. I don’t think it’s bad, but my expectations were a bit different.
- Financial disappointment. Even considering the significant chunk lost to U.S. taxes (due to the lack of a double taxation agreement), I managed to cover all direct expenses. However, my expectations were higher.

If you enjoyed the game, leaving a review would mean a lot.
If not… well, then don’t bother. :D

[h1][b]PLANS[/b][/h1]

[b]1. Legends of Savvarah: Children of the Sun.[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416490/Legends_of_Savvarah_Children_of_the_Sun/]LINK.
[/url]
The game will be released on January 23, 2024.

I've written a lot about the project in my reports, but let's break it down point by point:

- We'll find ourselves in Savvarah long before Hasvah from Gods of Savvarah was born. The war with the Horned Ones has just ended, and Akotal has not yet become a semi-divine tyrant.

- This is a technical step forward. We've got full map navigation and relatively free interactions with characters.

- A single playthrough will be significantly longer than The Time of the Pariah. Despite this, the game still retains its strong variability.

- There’s a lot of universe lore. You'll dive deep into cosmology while exploring the personal stories of the characters.

P.S. Sorry, the screenshots aren't translated yet—I'm still in the process of adding translations to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/608ab64d66843db9ddddb197a8899cbe5cd4c0b4.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/45e4a7ca4a894cec49eb4d164ace81df97ad0834.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/2d34f3f0e540ca6a04dbdd3894017b2fbf0564d8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/134d1c439273abf813201576d063be9ae9d8c5f8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/523f53b100ec0f47dd2ef26f7d55e05c687c275a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/4581d66e250e9502a5d1727faefb4e6bd8675c09.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/6305e308b304708422a93b71e11674e5bf042072.png[/img]

[b]2. Legends of Savvarah: Flowers and Scorpions.[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413920/Legends_of_Savvarah_Flowers_and_Scorpions/]LINK.[/url]
Scheduled for release in May 2025, though it might be delayed to June/July 2025.
It’s already well-developed but still needs assembly. Plus, I’m polishing the text to fix logical inconsistencies.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/47c26596dde695fa7de6239156797615b656d278.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/776fb2b63397e9907a3a7cbb05c45e2144e8b2ba.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/62e07567803948f512c3523a06efe2357afab307.jpg[/img]

[b]3. DLC for Legends of Savvarah: The Time of the Pariah.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/e887bf82e415c27885e8772cd59317bd65616633.jpg[/img]
A significant DLC is planned for June 2025.

For those who already own the game, it will be free. Details will follow next year, but here’s a preview:

- Expanded introduction to the story.
- More content around the Honey House and its residents. Expect more Viory and Otkor.
- Two new characters, including the Honey House’s Mistress.
- More Sudu, more Red Shiv.

Two more projects definitely won’t be released next year, but work on them is slowly progressing behind the scenes.

[b]4. Legends of Savvarah: Whisper. of The Ocean.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/99569e580aa6d9fb79596f92751d70f5f72ecdf8.jpg[/img]
It is planned to be a game with turn-based combat (not card-based), where you’ll have the opportunity to assemble a team—yes, much like in traditional RPGs. The setting is the tropical Ankar Archipelago.

The main character featured on the cover/banner is Atahira. Below is her image, along with one of the potential team members.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/3d825aa8b6a5964569d604332b1bf34d3f211728.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/5c877e57ede268aed2aa7ff5496685c06e47dd4e.jpg[/img]

[b]5. Legends of Savvara: Arachnum.[/b]
Arachnum is a province of the Julian Empire, where the dominant race is the Zkitani (insectoids).

The story takes place on Ertheon (the continent of beastfolk), over 800 years after the events of "The Time of the Pariah", when the war between the Dominion and Kradjan had long since ended. The remnants of Kradjan are now only the Aquatic Tigonia, while Ertheon is under the control of the Julian Empire (the Dominion’s successor).

Matius is a judge. He comes from a noble family of beastfolk. His father holds a prominent position in the Imperial Custoria (the local Presidential Administration), his brother is a deputy minister, and his grandfather was a city prefect and a high-ranking military officer.

Matius is appointed as the new Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of Arachnum, a province inhabited by insectoids.

It’s too early to say exactly what the game will be like, but conceptually, I’m drawing inspiration from Dave the Diver.

This is a narrative-driven adventure. You’ll play as a judge, resolving disputes and navigating between the Empire and the interests of the local nobility. Along the way, you’ll explore maps, engage in mini-games, and build relationships with other characters (yes, romantic interests are planned, including beastfolk, insectoids, and Takur).

The protagonist (yes, he’s a feline humanoid) will be joined by several characters you’ll encounter along the way:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/051c18ab7dcf65a03f1de349ca037836eb9df3c1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/7283c29d8afb18586776d25a459d3f2a35a8937b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/23a1af96e2009897989a1532f74f0cc029a96e72.jpg[/img]

Thank you for reading all the way to the end.

I hope the next year will be productive. If you’d like to support me, feel free to leave a comment here. I read everything everywhere. :)

Happy upcoming holidays! :)

notes.title: Work Report № 7 from March 08, 2024 (public)
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you for following our work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/b4567f4081c9787df81233625bb007904ceede5a.png[/img]

This is Report #7. The information is up-to-date as of the end of February 2024. A slightly more detailed report has been published on our [url=https://www.patreon.com/Sinovar]Patreon[/url]. (including sketches, but only sketches, 18+ scenes).

You can follow us in [url=https://twitter.com/SSinovar]Twitter[/url], as well as [url=https://www.reddit.com/user/SinovarST]Reddit[/url].

The beginning of the year has been incredibly busy. Because of this, I even thought that perhaps it would be worth giving up on reports, but on the other hand, someone is reading them. And it's kind of nice to show the results of our work.

I remind you again that several projects set in the world of Savvarah are in production. And this is a report about the work on them. "Gods of Savvarah," unfortunately, are still on hold.

[h1][b]1. "Time of Pariah".[/b][/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416500/Legends_of_Savvarah_Time_of_Pariah/]Add to wishlist. [/url]

Most importantly: the likelihood that they will be released in August 2024 is very high (I would say 90 percent), because we are moving towards this very confidently.

What's happening:

    1. We have started translating the text into English.
    2. I began assembling the game's code.
    3. The music is ready, so we decided to make additional tracks.
    4. The game's interface has been completely updated.
    5. All artworks for the epilogues are ready.
    6. All artworks for achievements are ready.
    7. Main images are being drawn, but they will be created closer to the release.
    8. We are in the process of creating images for lore articles. There will be 8 pieces (at least, that's the plan for now).

And now for the demonstration.

This is how the game looks now:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/292548ae2ecc60ef513949a3851d712e8acaac69.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/509429ef09e0750b39741ce6f1b8b119e2b53981.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/43db147753cd533f871f795f761f0f65eed44233.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/2c24de6ac5d77541bfafe581b63d99bcba93582a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/608909e24e7579efa9bbd5fd5bf900f12fa44c77.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/ab4f50bd09b3295fea70181b50610fdcc2590b62.png[/img]

These are examples of achievements:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/eba3be24f3cc744a79db20e6b61f68ff5d22ce90.jpg[/img]

I have shown examples of epilogues before, but here are some snippets from them:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/b0619f29a9fa694aa825611af30c28a1340ea360.jpg[/img]

And here are a couple of sketches for lore notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/039ec72d68ab16fa87f92c7128066a9d0313dd68.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/706b82d5a1f0e2bac691d5e5d99655825ba3d884.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/1812103bb0c361c8de6b19eea19a6bd316b75bd9.jpg[/img]

I hope to finish the coding work in 2-3 months. It's not difficult, but very tedious work. In a Word document, this is 506 pages of text (in fact more, because sometimes the text splits on the page). A large volume, because, I remind you, 23 endings and really a large variability.

[h1][b]2. "Children of the Sun".[/b][/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2416490/Legends_of_Savvarah_Children_of_the_Sun/]Add to wishlist.[/url]

I want to release it this year, but there's a good chance it won't happen on time. It's also quite a large project that should immerse you in the cosmogony of the world of Savvara.

Here we are working in a bunch of directions at once, but none of them have been completed yet.

We had a significant lag in terms of backgrounds. We had to change the artist in January 2024, but now several backgrounds are already ready. It is expected that there will be around 15-20.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/26a6760a06cd1870432c982090adf35ef5c1bfc9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/95b2c677436248cf08d6aee846993aa53a899069.png[/img]

Achievements are currently in the process of being created. Here are some:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/ad3cebdb006b3758da4f731f12244b64f1ba6b3c.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/0709e4b1154babd531be79ec4d523497ac369527.jpg[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/01fddd336554814d64b2ef578fe246428fc6595d.jpg[/img]

For "optimization," we came up with this thing. We have action episodes. For them, we decided to make these "cards". Here are examples:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/6c61e65b7b38cf9d2d07fd2f1f6fbf07f992d019.jpg[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/f4a13684aec785f2dd9a593c6e7d6bd56d6f2bd9.jpg[/img]

Epilogues are also in process, but I'm not showing them yet.

Other artworks are also being drawn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/830b27bea1fefea07a54bcc4df06d7744af14922.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/9777ab0f7b6a4629dc12b0a4a8e27295183c00c7.png[/img]

The text is ready, but not fully edited yet. In terms of volume, it's even larger than "Time of Pariah", although it's slightly less variable (13 endings).

The interface is also expected this month. If everything goes according to plan, we can start assembling the material around May-June 2024.

Thus, there are chances to release this project in the fall of 2024, but the risk of postponement is significant.

[h1][b]3. "Flowers and Scorpions".[/b][/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2413920/Legends_of_Savvarah_Flowers_and_Scorpions/]add it to your wishlist : ) [/url]

This project has been moved to 2025. I set the date as the beginning of 2025, but it's not exact. The fact is that after reviewing the editing, it was decided to significantly rework and add to the text. Most likely, I will only be able to tackle this closer to the end of summer 2024.

Nevertheless, we are still working on the game. But, let's say, less actively.

    1. Main artworks continue to be drawn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/aed18ca87bb5f4876a34ece959cceb17cde98eb7.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/4dc358c737906955fab1bf60fb8f5583f588462a.jpg[/img]
    2. We are drawing images for the epilogues. Here are a couple.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/4f2b2c8e9c0a7c088680c14dd1446219d17a024b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43081756/10f25cd6b791ce0d5d9ad8fc17f1cd3921ede044.jpg[/img]

You can read more info about world of Savvarah on [url=https://www.reddit.com/user/SinovarST]Reddit[/url].

Thank you for your attention.

notes.title: Update 7 August
notes.content:
Fixed minor bugs reported to us by players.

[list]
[*] Improved the overall stability of the game 
[*] Added studio logo 
[*] Fixed bugs in the original text and English translation.
[/list].
